info.name: School Management System API
info.description:
REST API for a School Management System (Node.js + Express, JWT, bcrypt, in-memory data).

HOW TO RUN
1. cd into the project and run `npm install`.
2. Copy .env.example to .env and set ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD / JWT_SECRET.
3. Start the API with `npm start` (default http://localhost:4000/api).
4. Import this collection into Postman or Thunder Client and run it TOP TO BOTTOM
   (Collection Runner -> sequential). Tokens and record ids are captured by the test
   scripts into collection variables, so the order matters.

DEFAULT CREDENTIALS (see .env / README)
  admin@school.test   / Admin@12345
  teacher@school.test / Teacher@12345
  student@school.test / Student@12345

WHAT IS COVERED
  Registration, login, JWT authentication, protected routes, role-based authorization
  (401/403), full CRUD for students/teachers/classes/subjects, result management,
  validation errors, conflict handling and global error handling.
